infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Keepsake uses the camera to scan QR codes on your items and take photos to attach to entries.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Keepsake needs photo library access so you can attach photos to your inventory items.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Keepsake to use your camera to scan item QR codes.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Keepsake to access your photos to attach images to inventory items.
